unlatched_review: Component 69 is the separate latch tongue at handle height and extends about 20 mm beyond the leaf edge toward the strike. Preserve its visual mesh while omitting only its collision for the common closed-unlatched push state. Leaf, frame, hinge and handles remain collidable.
clearance_review: Attempt 000006 showed proper source-surface crossings between the fitted leaf/handle hardware and both strike-side frame pieces and fixed hinge knuckles. The source leaf nearly fills the passage. Uniform 2% Panel/Handle fitting about the measured leaf center plus a 3.1 mm shift toward the latch distributes the predicted edge gaps to roughly 0.35 mm at the hinge and 0.8 mm at the strike; the opening origin is recentered on the fitted leaf. This is a bounded operating-clearance approximation to verify through the full sweep and previews, not manufacturer geometry. Runtime tolerances are unchanged.

collider_groups.review: The white and brass latch-side escutcheon, lock casing and handle-base fragments describe one rigid attached hardware assembly. Several are planar skins whose standalone PhysX decomposition thickens them into the fixed strike plate despite no source-surface crossings after fitting (attempt 000007). Cook a common solid envelope while retaining every visual component, the collidable assembly, and the separate lever-handle colliders. The separate latch tongue 69 remains the only excluded collider.
